Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NERAMAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Business Development Executive post is scheduled for 17th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Business Development Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a recognized University or Institute to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Business Development Executive post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Business Development Executive post is 30 years as of 1st October 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Business Development Executive position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month. This amount is negotiable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NERAMAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781019. The specific address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with the North Eastern Regional Agricultural Marketing Corporation (NERAMAC).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct link to the PDF will be provided.
